entries.description: SageMaker Unified Studio: Fixed Spaces not appearing in the tree view after signing in with SSO to an IAM-based domain (caught in pre-release).
Updated the AWS SDK credential provider so credentials refreshed by re-running `aws login` are recognized without restarting the IDE.
SageMaker Unified Studio: only activated user profiles are used for space filtering.
SageMaker Unified Studio: Automatically reconnect a deeplink-connected Space by refreshing credentials in the browser when the SSH tunnel drops.
